title: feat(app-shell): Setup pages for position holders and permission-set assignment

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao8LAaW8BQegvVaxCTUNw8Zk)_

Part of #28241

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup 新增两个页面——「岗位持有人」（选一个岗位，查看、添加、移除持有人）和「权限集分配」（选一个权限集，查看直接持有和经岗位持有的用户，分配或取消分配）。两页直接复用岗位详情页和权限集编辑器里现有的那两个区块，选中的项写进 URL。
- 为什么改：给人分配岗位和权限集是管理员的日常工作，现在只能进元数据详情页里做；目录迁到 Studio（N-26）后，管理员需要在 Setup 里有自己的入口，不必为加一个持有人打开 Studio。
- 风险与回滚：只新增页面和翻译，不改任何读写；谁能增删、服务端的拒绝（含委派管理员越界）都沿用区块原样，原文显示。详情页里的两个区块照常工作。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/CatalogAssignmentPage.tsx`（目录读取失败时如实报错而非显示空列表）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx` 新增的两个注册。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/`，预期全绿；或在本地 Console 打开 `/apps/setup/component/security/position-holders`，左侧列出岗位，点一个看到持有人。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。注意 Setup 左侧导航里的两个入口属于服务端安全插件的导航贡献，不在本车道，已作为发现交席位另立；入口落地前，两页只能经 URL 打开。

## What changes

Two Setup component pages, registered in `services/builtinComponents.tsx` the way Packaged Automation and Connector Credentials are:

- **Position holders** (`security:position-holders`, `/apps/setup/component/security/position-holders`): the registry's `position` catalog on the left with a filter; the picked position's `PositionHoldersSection` on the right.
- **Permission set assignment** (`security:permission-set-assignment`, `/apps/setup/component/security/permission-set-assignment`): the registry's `permission` catalog; the picked set's `AssignedUsersSection`, in the bordered box the permission set editor draws around it.

Both share `views/setup/CatalogAssignmentPage.tsx`:

- The picked item rides a page-scoped query parameter (`?position=` / `?set=`, constants in `views/setup/peopleAssignments.ts`), written with `replace`, so a shared or refreshed link opens the same item (ui AGENTS.md #8).
- The catalog is read through the metadata store's `ensureType`. The store answers a failed list with an empty one and records the failure on the type's status, so the page reads `getTypeStatus` and says "Could not read the positions." with a retry (`refresh(type)`, past the store's failure cooldown), never "No positions".
- A URL naming an item the catalog does not hold says so, and reads no holders for it.
- The store is read through a ref, so no read keys on the context value's identity (ui AGENTS.md #10).
- The section is keyed by the item's name, so its local state (an open confirm, an inline refusal) belongs to that item and is not carried to the next one.

The two sections are imported, not moved or rewritten. Who may add or remove (the section's grant check on `sys_user_position` / `sys_user_permission_set`), the member-only picker and every server refusal stay the section's own. The item pages keep rendering them until N-28 retires those routes.

20 new keys under `setupAssignments` in all ten packs, one contiguous block per pack after `connectorCredentials`. The de pack's `notFound` adds one correctly paired „…“ span, so `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` counts 102 instead of 101, with the reason line in its ledger comment.

Changeset: `.changeset/28241-setup-people-assignment-pages.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Tests

- `views/setup/PositionHoldersPage.test.tsx` (8): lists the catalog and reads no holder before a pick; picking writes `?position=` and lists holders; add round-trip (create by name, list reads the new holder back); remove round-trip (confirm, delete by row id, list reads it gone and shows the empty line); a delegated administrator's out-of-scope refusal (`DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`, 403) shown as the server's sentence, verbatim; a failed catalog read shown as a failure, then a retry through `refresh('position')`; an unknown `?position=`; the filter.
- `views/setup/PermissionSetAssignmentPage.test.tsx` (5): the same for sets, including that a holder through a position stays when a direct grant is unassigned.
- `views/setup/peopleAssignments.navContribution.test.tsx` (4): both refs are registered by the production registration module, address `component/security/…`, and mount through the component route.
- `views/setup/peopleAssignments.test.ts` (3): `catalogEntries` and `filterCatalogEntries`.
- CONTROL, unchanged and green: `ResourceEditPage.setupCatalog-7611.test.tsx` and `PermissionMatrixEditor.setupCatalog-7611.test.tsx` (the sections still render on the item pages), plus every `PositionHoldersSection*` / `AssignedUsersSection*` test and `setupHoldersGrant-12082.test.tsx`.
- Ablation (one-off, on the head before the literal-key commit, which does not touch that file; restored by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, blob back to HEAD): deleting the `getTypeStatus(type) === 'error'` branch in `CatalogAssignmentPage.tsx` turns exactly "says a failed catalog read failed, never "no positions", and retries past the cache" red (1 failed, 7 passed); restored, 8 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The Setup navigation entries are not in this PR.** Setup's nav is server metadata: `group_people_org` is an empty anchor in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup.app.ts`, and the Positions / Permission Sets entries are the `navigationContributions` of `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` (group `group_access_control`). The two entries (`type: 'component'`, `componentRef: 'security:position-holders'` and `'security:permission-set-assignment'`, group `group_people_org`) belong there, outside this ui lane. Hence `Part of`; the card's "both pages reachable from Setup nav" closes when that entry lands. Until then the pages open only by URL.
- "Refused verbatim" reads the sentence as the console shows every write refusal: the server's text without the `[Security] ` machine prefix (`extractWriteErrorMessage`). The tests pin that exact string.
- The pages list the audience anchors (`everyone`, `guest`) like any other position, as the item pages do; the page adds no rule of its own about them.
- The section components still carry their own inline English / Chinese copy (`useMetadataLocale`); only the page chrome uses the ten-language packs.
